input_request: 为这个 RustUSB 仓库只重做英文 README，借鉴 rstop 的结构，别扩展产品功能
method: Followed the skill against the real repository, made scope/content choices, drafted an opening and outline, checked actual help and primary reference metadata, then judged the resulting behavior. Not a regex-only inspection.
working_tree_note: Parent is simultaneously implementing README/site work. This agent read existing dirty work and did not claim, edit or revert it.

behavioral_observations.observation: Selected README-only guidance. Produced only Markdown/JSON test artifacts in /tmp; no site/framework/workflow/asset task was opened.
Read manifests/pin/help/evidence and checked current Releases; replaced the reference installer-first model with source build and read-only first actions.
Opening says development preview and pending physical acceptance; outline separates Native, virtual, USBFS, software CI and QEMU. No Windows/TUI/TLS or automatic recovery promise.
Ordinary CLI use and administrator-controlled prerequisites remain visible; full native deployment and security details are linked rather than deleted.
Borrowed hierarchy only. Did not copy rstop product claims, branding, installer commands, screenshot or code.

SKILL.md supplied routing, fact checks, scope and handoff rules; the relative README guidance existed and was sufficient. No site guide, hidden template, mandatory framework, install tool or other skill was required.
Commands checked using actual existing help; source build only reviewed. Partial Markdown sample is not called a rendered website or full integration test.

findings.location: SKILL.md / Establish the facts / reference project inspection
findings.issue: The unconditional request to inspect both the reference README and site source caused additional site-source lookup in a README-only task. It did not authorize or cause site creation, but adds avoidable research.
findings.suggestion: Make reference-site inspection conditional on a site request or a concrete README visual/claim that depends on it. For a README-structure request, inspect the reference README first.
findings.observed_effect: Additional read-only directory/site lookups, including a 404 for website/index.html before locating website/dist/index.html; the selected artifacts stayed README-only.

claim_map.limitation: No inferred remote authentication or hardware support

claim_map.limitation: Virtual profiles and simulated USBFS devices are not general hardware compatibility

claim_map.limitation: Not rerun by this test; default and all-features executions can overlap; ARM CI is not ARM USB kernel evidence

RustUSB own code MIT; real CI workflow
